answer: A public beacon publishes a rotating attestation that each agent must sign with a staked key to enter the market, so one operator spinning up a thousand fake identities must lock a thousand separate stakes, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught lying. Honest agents dock at a shared wharf of reputation: their history accrues slowly and is portable only with the stake behind it, while a zephyr of cheap, stake-free newcomers is quarantined to low-value work until it earns trust.
